containers.name: pusher
args: set -ex; SOCKET=/run/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock; REGISTRY=10.53.223.183:5000; echo 'Tagging image...'; /host/ctr -a $SOCKET -n k8s.io images tag docker.io/rancher/mirrored-library-nginx:1.24.0-alpine $REGISTRY/alpine:latest; echo 'Pushing to registry...'; /host/ctr -a $SOCKET -n k8s.io images push --plain-http $REGISTRY/alpine:latest $REGISTRY/alpine:latest; echo 'Verifying...'; apk add --no-cache curl; curl -s http://$REGISTRY/v2/_catalog; curl -s http://$REGISTRY/v2/alpine/tags/list; echo 'Done'
